explication: media-elements is a collection of HTMLMediaElement-compatible custom elements and add-ons. The principal workflow is that a page uses a media element to present or control media through a native, streaming, or third-party player; optional add-ons provide track/rendition APIs, played-range behavior, and casting. The README documents the product capabilities and integrations, while the sampled source shows internals for casting and media tracks. Other adapters are represented from their tree paths and README descriptions; their internal call relationships were not sampled.
